# CodeChef

> CodeChef is a competitive programming platform offering DSA learning, coding practice problems, and interview preparation across multiple programming languages.

CodeChef provides a comprehensive learning environment for aspiring developers to master data structures, algorithms, and competitive programming through hands-on problem-solving. The platform supports major programming languages including Python, Java, C++, and C, making it accessible to developers at all skill levels.

## Key Topics

- Competitive Programming
- Data Structures & Algorithms (DSA)
- Python
- Java
- C++
- C
- Practice Problems
- Interview Preparation
- Coding Challenges
- Programming Courses
- Career Development
- Web Development
- React JS
- Problem Solving

## Core Platform

- [CodeChef - Learn and Practice Coding with Problems](https://www.codechef.com): Main CodeChef platform for learning Python, Java, C++, C with DSA problems and competitive programming
